correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact Irwin-Hall inclusion-exclusion computes volume of [-1,1]^d intersect |sum x_i|<=t. Polar is convex hull of cross-polytope with +/- t^{-1}(1,...,1); visible-facet exterior pyramids have disjoint interiors and give W_d(t)=[2^d+2 sum binom(d,j)((d-2j)/t-1)_+]/d!. For 0<t<=1 the polar volume is (B_d/t+C_d)/d!, while strict unimodality of uniform-cube sum densities gives odd-dimensional decreasing product and positive even-dimensional right slope. In d=3 exact branches give 32/3 minima at t=1,3, one interior local maximum at the unique Q-root, and unattained supremum 12 as t approaches 0. Independent exact Fraction checks verified all d=2..8 cube endpoint identities, nine d=2..10 small-width parity inequalities, and every sampled d=3 rational t. They do not prove universal dimensions.
residual_risks: Do not interpret t=0 as a full-dimensional Mahler product; 12 is an unattained limit.
No all-dimensional global optimization beyond the near-zero parity behavior.
